dataList.name: Don Quixote... Please focus on the task at hand.
dataList.desc:
In the Team Loadout menu:
- Equipping <noparse>Wedge Office</noparse> Fixer Sinclair automatically equips Don Quixote's Identity as <noparse>Wedge Office</noparse> Fixer Don Quixote
- When <noparse>Wedge Office</noparse> Fixer Don Quixote is unequipped, automatically equip the most recently equipped Identity that isn't <noparse>Wedge Office</noparse> Fixer Sinclair (If <noparse>Wedge Office</noparse> Fixer Sinclair Identity was already equipped when entering the Team Loadout menu, removing this Identity will automatically equip the LCB Sinner Sinclair Identity instead)

From Turn Start ~ before Combat Start: If this unit's Speed is slower than allied <noparse>Wedge Office</noparse> Fixer Don Quixote Identity's Speed, become faster until their Speed values are equal (this effect does not activate if either of the two Identities is at -45 SP, or is under an effect that fixes their Speed)
dataList.summary:
When Deployed, automatically Deploy the counterpart Identity for Don Quixote
If this unit's Speed is slower than Don Quixote's, become faster until their Speed values are equal

dataList.name: Wedge Drive
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: Gain 1 [BattleFieldKnow]

If any of the following conditions are met, inflict 1 [WedgeMarkGreen] on the main target (once per turn)
- On final Coin Hit using an Attack Skill against the main target
- Upon using this unit's Evade Skill to successfully evade all of the attacker's Coins
dataList.summary:
Turn Start: Gain [BattleFieldKnow]
When conditions are met, inflict [WedgeMarkGreen] on the main target

dataList.name: Back-to-back in Dawnbreak's Light
dataList.desc:
When the allied <noparse>Dawn Office</noparse> Fixer Faust Identity uses the "Dismemberment at High Noon" Skill, the Skill's Coin 2 gains the following effects (once per turn):
- [ComboSkill]: <noparse>Wedge Office</noparse> Fixer Sinclair
  · [OnSucceedAttack] Inflict 2 [Combustion] and +2 [Combustion] Count
  · [OnSucceedAttack] Inflict 2 [Vibration]
  · [OnSucceedAttack] Inflict 1 [WedgeMarkGreen]
  · [OnSucceedAttack] Allied <noparse>Wedge Office</noparse> Rep Outis Identity gains 1 [ComboWedgeDawn]
dataList.summary: On Combo Attack, On Hit using the "Dismemberment at High Noon" Skill's Coin 2, inflict [Combustion], [Vibration], [WedgeMarkGreen], and [Combustion] Count; Outis gains [ComboWedgeDawn]

dataList.name: Hunters of the City
dataList.desc:
Combat End: At 10+ [Breath] Potency, gain 1 [Agility] next turn

At more than 20 [Breath] Potency, Base Skills deal +(excess Potency)% damage on Critical Hit (max 25%)
dataList.summary:
At sufficient [Breath] Potency, gain [Agility] next turn
At excess [Breath] Potency, Base Skills deal more damage on Critical Hit
dataList.flavor:
The streets of the City are never short of vile and savage company after dark. Rats desperate to turn their lives around, denizens of the Backstreets harboring dreams of revenge, Syndicates and Fingers embroiled in struggles over their interests... and, of course, the Sweepers.

For all the fortunes to be made from working after sundown, few Fixers are eager to accept such contracts. There are, however, those who find their greatest opportunities precisely where others dare not tread.

The discernment to read any situation with remarkable precision. The swiftness and thoroughness to bring a job to its conclusion without inviting further trouble. With these two qualities as its greatest assets, Wedge Office has weathered every contract and walked away with the handsome compensation that follows.

dataList.name: Keeping Pace
dataList.desc:
Turn End: Apply 1 [Agility] next turn on the allied Identity with the slowest Speed (prioritize "Fixer" Identities)
- If the said Identity is a "Fixer", apply 1 [AttackUp] and 1 [Agility] next turn instead
dataList.summary:
Apply [Agility] next turn for the slowest ally
If the said ally is a "Fixer", apply [Agility] and [AttackUp] next turn
